title: pnpm applies a local patch to a published dependency
description: pnpm-lock.yaml declares a pnpm patch entry that rewrites a published package before install. The installed code differs from the package the registry published and from the code an advisory range describes, so review and matching both drift.
remediation: Publish the fix through a maintained fork with its own review, and record why the patch is needed.
limitation: It matches a pnpm patch entry that rewrites a published package before install in the parsed pnpm-lock.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
